annotations.title: Get prices of a model in all its versions

description: Prices of one model across all its versions and Polish stores, e.g. "RTX 5070" (every manufacturer's card), "iPhone 17 Pro 256 GB" (every colour), "PlayStation 5 Pro": the cheapest versions now with their stores, the price range, the price history of the model's cheapest version (lowest ever, last 30 days, weekly lowest prices for 12 weeks) and TagDip's "buy now or wait?" in Polish. Use it for questions about a model rather than one exact product. Pass model_id from search_products, or query with the model name.

limit.description: How many of the cheapest versions to list (default 8).

query.description: Instead of model_id: the model name, e.g. "rtx 5070".

name: get_model_prices
title: Get prices of a model in all its versions
